description.zh:
预付费周期（月），如果转换为预付费类型，需要设置购买的预付费的周期时长。取值：
- 1~9。
- 12。
- 24。
- 36。
description.en:
The subscription duration. Unit: months. This parameter is required if you switch the billing method to subscription. Valid values:

*   1 to 9
*   12
*   24
*   36
The code of the service to which the instance belongs.
The type of the service to which the instance belongs.

description.zh:
实例当前的付费类型，取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。

> 调用成功后资源将被更变为相反的类型。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

*   Subscription: subscription
*   PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go

>  After the call is successful, the billing method of the instance is switched.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi convert-charge-type --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --period 6 --product-code rds --instance-id rm-kasjgfjshgf --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi ConvertChargeType --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --ProductCode rds --InstanceId 'rm-kasjgfjshgf' --ProductType rds --Period 6
